For several months, I repeatedly tried to book an emergency (same-day) appointment, following their instructions to call during specific morning hours. Every single time, the line was either constantly engaged or the phone was left off the hook making it impossible to get through until the booking window had closed.

One day, I went in person and explained the situation. The receptionist told me there were no appointments left and that I had to call. I showed her my phone log, which showed hundreds of outgoing calls over the previous week. She simply shrugged and repeated that I need to call  even though no one ever picks up.

The next morning, I returned to the practice, sat inside, and called again  this time while watching the receptionist completely ignore the ringing phone. She just sat there doing nothing while calls went unanswered.

This is not just frustrating it’s unacceptable. It goes against patients’ rights under the NHS Scotland Patients’ Charter, which guarantees timely access to care. It also raises serious concerns about whether this practice is meeting its obligations under NHS regulations.

If you value your health, avoid this place. It’s not just poor service – it’s a failure of basic
